QuestInfo.name: [Home] Decorating the House
QuestInfo.0: You bought a lovely #t2671002:# from Miranda's shop. Go home and hang it up!
QuestInfo.1:
Place the #t2672016:# Alvin brought you and the #t2671002:# you bought at Miranda's shop.


#b#e[Tip: Placing Furnishings]#n
1. Double-click a furnishing item in your inventory to transfer it to the [Furnishing Storage].
2. Click #i3801391# button in the the Home menu to open [Furnishing Storage].
3. Double-click the furnishing you want to place or click the [Place] button while it's highlighted.
4. After clicking the location where you want to place the furnishing, click the [Confirm Placement] button.
QuestInfo.2: After placing #t2672016:# and #t2671002:# in your home, the house doesn't feel so empty. Now it's time to invite the guests!
